name: Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A.
summary: Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A. operates as a regional development bank in Latin America. It operates through Own Portfolio and FNE segments. The company offers savings accounts, demand and time deposits, and custody of securities; specialized credit; credit for infrastructure, and urban and rural microfinance; and collection services and credit cards. It is also involved in structuring and distribution of securities, such as debentures, notes, promissory notes, real estate receivables certificates, investment funds; third-party asset management, consisting of the management of investment funds; foreign exchange operations; portfolio management and credit analysis; and electronic transfers.…
